label: Refinitiv Instrument Code
definition: Instrument code on which the static and panel extracts are merged.

label: Fiscal year
definition: Fiscal year of the observation. Where the extract supplies a reporting date that date is authoritative; where it does not, the year follows from the row's position within the firm's block, which arrives newest first.
transformation: calendar year of the reporting date, or position-assigned
analytical_role: panel index; year fixed effects in the pooled specification

label: Fiscal year assigned by position
definition: Indicator equal to one where the firm-year carried no reporting date and its year was assigned by position.

label: EMI score
definition: Environmental management and innovation score: the equal-weight mean of the resource-use and environmental-innovation theme scores, defined only where both themes are present.
source_field: Resource Use Score; Environmental Innovation Score
transformation: mean of the two themes, 0-100 scale

label: Resource-use theme score
definition: Provider theme score for resource use, entered on its own as one component of the composite.

label: Environmental-innovation theme score
definition: Provider theme score for environmental innovation, entered on its own as the second component of the composite.

label: Emissions theme score
definition: Provider emissions theme score, excluded from the composite because it scores the outcome the analysis treats as the dependent variable.

label: Three-theme mean
definition: Equal-weight mean of the resource-use, environmental-innovation and emissions theme scores, defined only where all three are present.
source_field: Resource Use Score; Environmental Innovation Score; Emissions Score

label: First principal component of the two themes
definition: First principal component of the two standardised theme scores, oriented so that a higher value means a higher score. An outcome-blind data-driven weighting, reported alongside the equal-weight default.
source_field: Resource Use Score; Environmental Innovation Score
transformation: standardised, then first eigenvector of the covariance matrix

label: Environmental pillar score
definition: Provider environmental pillar score. Excluded from the composite because the provider builds it from the resource-use, emissions and innovation categories, so it would double count two of its own inputs.

label: ESG score
definition: Provider overall ESG score across all three pillars.

label: ESG combined score
definition: Provider ESG score adjusted for controversies.

label: Carries both theme scores
definition: Indicator equal to one where both the resource-use and the environmental-innovation theme scores are present. Defines the rated cross-section and is the outcome of the first selection gate.
source_field: Resource Use Score; Environmental Innovation Score

label: Scope 1+2 emissions
definition: Operational emissions: the sum of the direct Scope 1 and indirect Scope 2 CO2-equivalent fields, defined only where both are present, so that the boundary is explicit rather than taken from the provider's aggregate.
source_field: CO2 Equivalent Emissions Direct, Scope 1; CO2 Equivalent Emissions Indirect, Scope 2
transformation: sum of the two components, tonnes CO2e

label: Scope 3 emissions
definition: Value-chain emissions as reported by the provider, analysed separately from operational emissions and never added to them, the two boundaries answering different questions.

label: Log Scope 1+2
definition: Natural logarithm of operational emissions, defined only on strictly positive values; firms reporting exactly zero are counted and excluded rather than coerced.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log Scope 3
definition: Natural logarithm of value-chain emissions, defined only on strictly positive values.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Emissions figure is firm-reported
definition: Indicator equal to one where the provider records the emissions figure as reported by the firm rather than estimated, and missing where no method flag is carried.
transformation: indicator on the method flag equalling Reported

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of revenue
definition: Natural logarithm of operational emissions divided by revenue. The headline intensity measure, revenue being the most widely used and the most comparable denominator across studies.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive revenue, then natural log

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of total assets
definition: Natural logarithm of operational emissions divided by total assets.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive assets, then natural log

label: Log Scope 1+2 per employee
definition: Natural logarithm of operational emissions divided by full-time employees. A physical rather than a financial denominator, so it does not move with valuation or accounting choices.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive employees, then natural log

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of enterprise value
definition: Natural logarithm of operational emissions divided by enterprise value.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive enterprise value, then natural log

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of energy use
definition: Natural logarithm of operational emissions divided by total energy use. The second physical denominator.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive energy use, then natural log

label: Log Scope 3 per unit of revenue
definition: Natural logarithm of value-chain emissions divided by revenue. Scope 3 is scaled by the same five denominators as Scope 1+2; revenue and total assets are the two reported.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive revenue, then natural log

label: Log Scope 3 per unit of total assets
definition: Natural logarithm of value-chain emissions divided by total assets.
transformation: ratio on strictly positive assets, then natural log

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of revenue, sector-demeaned
definition: Log revenue intensity less the median of the same intensity within the firm's TRBC economic sector and fiscal year, so that a firm's position within its sector is separated from the level of the sector itself.

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of assets, sector-demeaned
definition: Log asset intensity less its sector-year median.

label: Log Scope 1+2 per employee, sector-demeaned
definition: Log employee intensity less its sector-year median.

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of enterprise value, sector-demeaned
definition: Log enterprise-value intensity less its sector-year median.

label: Log Scope 1+2 per unit of energy use, sector-demeaned
definition: Log energy intensity less its sector-year median.

label: Waste recycling rate
definition: Recycled waste over total waste, on strictly positive total waste, set missing where the ratio exceeds one. A rate rather than a tonnage, since recycled tonnage is not a recycling rate.

label: Hazardous share of waste
definition: Hazardous waste over total waste, on strictly positive total waste.

label: Log recycled waste
definition: Natural logarithm of recycled waste tonnage, defined only on strictly positive values.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log total waste
definition: Natural logarithm of total waste tonnage, defined only on strictly positive values.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log market capitalisation
definition: Natural logarithm of company market capitalisation in US dollars. The control carried in every outcome model.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log total assets
definition: Natural logarithm of total assets in US dollars.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log revenue
definition: Natural logarithm of revenue in US dollars.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log employees
definition: Natural logarithm of full-time employees.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log enterprise value
definition: Natural logarithm of enterprise value in US dollars.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Log energy use
definition: Natural logarithm of total energy use.
transformation: natural log on strictly positive values

label: Return on assets
definition: Net income before extraordinary items over total assets, on strictly positive assets.
source_field: Net Income Incl Extra Before Distributions; Total Assets

label: Leverage
definition: Total debt over total assets, on strictly positive assets.

label: Free float
definition: Percentage of shares in free float, used as the available proxy for institutional ownership, which the provider does not supply under its own name.

label: Firm age
definition: Observation year less founding year. A founding year outside 1500 to the observation year is treated as missing, since a missing value arrives as zero.
transformation: difference in years, implausible values set missing

label: ESG reporting scope
definition: Provider measure of the share of the group covered by the firm's sustainability reporting, used as one indicator of reporting maturity.

label: Reports under GRI guidelines
definition: Indicator for reporting under the Global Reporting Initiative guidelines. Populated for a minority of firms and nearly constant among them, so it is used descriptively rather than as a covariate.

label: Scope 1+2 available
definition: Indicator equal to one where an operational emissions figure exists for the firm-year, whether the firm reported it or the provider estimated it. The outcome of the availability gate.

label: Scope 3 available
definition: Indicator equal to one where a value-chain emissions figure exists for the firm-year.

label: Firm-reported Scope 1+2 available
definition: Indicator equal to one where an operational emissions figure exists and the estimation-method flag records it as reported by the firm. The strict reading of disclosure, used as a sensitivity on the availability gate.
transformation: indicator on a non-missing value and a flag value

label: Figure is the firm's own
definition: Among firm-years carrying both an emissions figure and an estimation-method flag, equal to one where the figure is firm-reported and zero where the provider estimated it; missing elsewhere.

label: Total waste available
definition: Indicator equal to one where a total waste figure exists for the firm-year.

label: TRBC economic sector
definition: Provider economic sector, the coarsest of the five classification levels and the industry control in the main models. Complete for every rated firm.

label: TRBC business sector
definition: Provider business sector, the next level down, used to test whether a finer industry classification changes the estimates.

label: TRBC industry group
definition: Provider industry group, the third classification level, retained for description.

label: Carbon-intensive sector
definition: Indicator equal to one for firms in Energy, Utilities or Basic Materials, the sectors conventionally treated as carbon intensive.

label: Sector carbon intensity
definition: Median log Scope 1+2 per unit of revenue within the firm's sector and fiscal year: a continuous alternative to the carbon-intensive indicator.
transformation: sector-year median of the log revenue intensity

label: Country
definition: Country of headquarters, falling back to country of exchange where the headquarters field is absent.
source_field: Country of Headquarters; Country of Exchange

label: Country group
definition: Country of the firm, with any country holding fewer than 25 firms pooled into a residual group. Absorbs national differences in regulation, energy systems and disclosure institutions, and is also the clustering variable.

label: Country group, 10-firm cutoff
definition: The same grouping at a 10-firm cutoff, estimated with clustering on the corresponding grouping so that the choice of cutoff is shown to be immaterial.

label: Country group, 50-firm cutoff
definition: The same grouping at a 50-firm cutoff.

label: Return on assets, winsorised
definition: Return on assets clipped at its 1st and 99th percentiles. Winsorisation enters as a robustness check rather than the default, so the main estimates are not conditioned on a trimming rule.
analytical_role: robustness: tails in the accounting ratios

label: Leverage, winsorised
definition: Leverage clipped at its 1st and 99th percentiles.
analytical_role: robustness: tails in the accounting ratios

label: Waste recycling rate, winsorised
definition: Recycling rate clipped at its 1st and 99th percentiles.
analytical_role: robustness: tails in the waste ratios

label: Hazardous share, winsorised
definition: Hazardous share clipped at its 1st and 99th percentiles.
analytical_role: robustness: tails in the waste ratios

label: Inverse-probability weight
definition: Weight formed from the fitted propensity of the availability gate, truncated at 0.02 and 0.98 and normalised to a mean of one. Overlap and the effective sample size are reported alongside the weighted estimates rather than assumed adequate.
transformation: one over the fitted propensity, truncated and normalised

label: Entropy-balancing weight
definition: Weight that makes the observed firms' means on log market capitalisation, log total assets, return on assets, leverage and firm age match those of the whole rated population, so balance on those moments holds by construction.
transformation: exponential tilt solving the moment conditions
